description: Lena owns a vintage photographic enlarger and must decide whether to accept an informal barter arrangement for it, then finalize the exchange and safe-use terms with the people gathered at a neighborhood photo-club gear swap.

shared_context.S1: Lena brought one vintage photographic enlarger to the neighborhood photo-club gear swap.
shared_context.S2: Lena will make the final call about whether to part with the enlarger and on what terms.
shared_context.S3: Lena has been looking for hands-on darkroom instruction to improve her own printing, so a useful mentoring arrangement matters to her in addition to cash.
shared_context.S4: At this gear swap, owners normally ask each participant in turn to use the formal disclosure step to put any concrete offer, comparison, or equipment-use finding on the record; Lena then reads back the recorded terms and asks the owners to confirm them before closing an informal deal.

PF1.text: Omar's specific proposal is to take the enlarger in exchange for exactly three two-hour darkroom mentoring sessions, with no cash changing hands, and to collect it Saturday at 11:00.

PF2.text: Felix tested the enlarger and knows it needs a 120-volt, 75-watt bulb. Felix also checked Omar's darkroom setup and knows Omar uses 230 volts, so Felix can lend Omar a 230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for the first month.

PF3.text: June is prepared to pay exactly $250 in cash for the enlarger and can collect it Saturday at 15:00; June has not yet stated this offer aloud.

acceptance_conditions: The enlarger must be traded to Omar.
The exchange must include exactly three two-hour darkroom mentoring sessions and no cash payment.
Pickup must be set for Saturday at 11:00.
The power arrangement must specify a 230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for Omar for the first month.
A transformer-loan commitment targeting Omar must be recorded.
The exact $250 cash alternative must be recorded for comparison.
Felix's electrical finding must be cited as justification for the power arrangement.
Omar's exact barter proposal must be cited as justification for the selected exchange.
June's $250 cash offer must be cited as the comparison basis.

content_checks.C4: decisions['power_setup'] == '230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for Omar for first month'
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'transformer_loan' and c['target'] == 'Omar' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Omar's exact proposal changes the selected partner to Omar, sets the exchange at exactly three mentoring sessions with zero cash, fixes pickup at Saturday 11:00, and supplies the proposal that must be cited.

Felix's test changes the power term to a 230-to-120-volt transformer specifically for Omar's 230-volt setup and creates the transformer-loan commitment that must be justified by Felix's spoken finding.
June's offer changes the comparison record to exactly $250 cash and supplies the alternative bid Lena must cite when evaluating Omar's barter.
